note: Each arm of the period-column rule: a column the table does not list (names are exact, so a case twin of a listed column misses), a period column on a year-independent table, and one on a one-token edition, which delivers a single period. The valid declaration is the period-column compile case.
fails_if: load_inventory admits a period column the table does not deliver, or one on a table with no periods to filter between

message_contains: period column 'INDATUM' is not a column of the table
a year-independent table has no period column
